question: Check count-only evidence coverage for daridorexant in pregnancy across PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, DailyMed, LactMed and MPRINT. Explain what each count does and does not establish.
criteria: Use count-only probes. LactMed is lactation-only and not applicable to pregnancy. Do not equate counts or zero matches with evidence quality or safety. Preserve unknown versus zero.
answer:
## Count-only evidence coverage for daridorexant in pregnancy

This lookup returned counts only; no full records, abstracts, trial results, labels, or clinical outcomes were retrieved. Counts are not comparable across sources and do not establish evidence quality, clinical safety, or what studies found.

| Source | Count/status | What the count establishes | What it does not establish |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **PubMed** | **3 matches** | Three records matched the supplied daridorexant–pregnancy query. The query reported that the daridorexant MeSH phrase was not found. [S4](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) | It does not establish verified human outcomes, distinct studies, or evidence quality. |
| **ClinicalTrials.gov** | **4 matches** | Four registrations matched `daridorexant AND (pregnancy)`. [S1](https://clinicaltrials.gov/) | It does not establish posted results, enrollment, outcomes, or confirmed age-band applicability. |
| **DailyMed** | **1 match** | One name-matched product label was returned. [S2](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/) | It does not establish population-specific sections, current FDA approval, or independent evidence. |
| **LactMed** | **Not applicable; no count** | LactMed is lactation-only. | It is not pregnancy or general pediatric evidence. |
| **MPRINT Gold snapshot** | **0 rows; 0 distinct PMIDs** | No literal daridorexant-name row matches were found in the selected MPRINT Gold snapshot tables. Snapshot date: **November 17, 2026**. [S3](https://github.com/langli-lab/mprint-kp-data) | This does not establish that no relevant research exists elsewhere. The returned caveat limits the result to literal drug-name matches in selected snapshot tables; MPRINT rows are not distinct studies. |

**Overall:** The returned material is presence/count navigation only. A positive count does not establish pregnancy outcomes, and a zero or not-applicable result does not establish safety or absence of evidence elsewhere. The lookup did not retrieve full evidence.
